_comment: Test scripts for VOICE_TEST_PLAN.md. The lab prompts these one line at a time and stamps the expected line onto each turn, which is what lets scripts/score-voice-log.mjs grade a round without a human re-reading transcripts. Step labels are the real seeded ones from server/db.js — if the seed changes, change these.

R-core.label: the whole test, 7 minutes
R-core.note: One connection, one download, no reconnects. Answers the four questions that gate Stage C. Read straight through; don't stop between blocks.

R-cal.label: voice separation, longer sample
R-cal.group: Follow-ups — only if R-core flags something
R-cal.note: Alternate speakers, one line each, normal speaking voice. There is NO voice enrollment in AssemblyAI — nothing here teaches the API your voices. This measures whether its diarization separates them on its own, and learns which label (A/B) is whose. Lines are deliberately long so none falls under the ~1s PENDING threshold.
